title: HowlPlane Test Impact Assessment
description: Structured Test Impact Assessment recorded in the evidence ledger (action test_impact_assessed) before a code-changing task is declared complete.

duplicate_or_obsolete_tests_reviewed.description: True once existing tests were reviewed for duplicate, obsolete or misnamed contracts.

full_regression_required.description: Whether the risk of this change requires the full regression gate before completion.

regression_commands_run.description: Commands actually run against the final tree. Required when full_regression_required is true.

rationale.description: Why this test scope is sufficient, including why any removed test no longer adds protection.
